required_stages.description: Allocate the (2N,) output of A's dtype inside run().
Single device pass reading A and B once each and writing OUT once with OUT[2i]=A[i], OUT[2i+1]=B[i].

forbidden_substitutions.message: strided slice assignment performs the interleave in PyTorch
torch.stack/torch.cat on the inputs computes the interleave in PyTorch
flatten/view after a PyTorch stack would be a torch-side interleave
PyTorch copy of an input or output

required_evidence.message: a device-side store of the interleaved tile

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh (2N,) tensor allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: The only host work is the output allocation; it is inside run() and timed. No prepacked inputs, no cross-call cache.
